design_state: decision-complete engineering protocol; native execution requires either an accepted same-recipe scoring coupon or explicit unqualified X/Y/Z engineering allowances

score_allowance.status: missing; native runs require accepted coupon evidence or explicit engineering assumptions
score_allowance.note: Do not substitute zero or infer an allowance from caliper. Accepted coupon evidence must match the selected literature2009 recipe; an explicit engineering allowance enables only unqualified simulation.

target.mesh_status: flat blank generated only after accepted matching coupon evidence or explicitly labeled engineering allowances; no folded shipping mesh is pre-authored
target.source_identity: literature2009 mixed-source C-flute proxy; not same-lot reconstruction

corrugated_geometry.profile: sinusoidal fallback, normal-thickness medium, partial terminal period clipped at the authored perimeter

numerical_solver_protocol.status: numerical configuration, not a material parameter or qualification result

score_tool_protocol.depth_study_execution: one selected depth per invocation from a freshly constructed flat blank; separate depth runs are never cumulative
score_tool_protocol.step_count: derived from stroke travel, requested speed, and timestep; per-action step cap enforced
score_tool_protocol.support_geometry: two native BOX support rails per score line, each on the shared support kinematic body; rails are separated by the 6 mm channel and aligned to that score line

closure_plan.method: all glued with hot-melt adhesive (HMA); no tape material system
closure_plan.adhesive_grade: engineering default not yet selected or calibrated

manufacturer_joint.adhesive_pattern: one centered 10 mm strip along the full wall-height lap
manufacturer_joint.activation: only after accepted native geometry shows paired faces in overlap and below the specified gap limit

ends.per_patch_geometry: flapDepth x flapDepth, with flapDepth=(200 mm + accepted width-axis score allowance)/2
ends.adhesive_pattern: one centered 10 mm strip spanning each actual major/minor overlap patch

compression.first_contact_crossing_rule: the first accepted 0.25 mm platen increment that yields native contact is counted as stroke from a zero-force contact origin; subsequent increments fill only the remaining distance to the 140 mm total ceiling
compression.stop: latch the first rising local peak after two accepted declines and at least a 1 percent drop, continue accepted loading through the 70 percent stroke endpoint, then require nominal-versus-half-speed peak force within 2 percent, full-stroke work within 2 percent, and maximum normalized full-curve difference within 5 percent; reject on any failed transaction

fpeak.status: must be measured by native platen reaction and accepted before impact masses are instantiated

half_speed_series.curve_comparison_domain: shared accepted stroke interval from the zero-force contact origin through the 70 percent inside-height endpoint, including postpeak response
half_speed_series.work_method: trapezoidal integral of mean native platen reaction over accepted stroke
half_speed_series.kinetic_method: sum of 0.5 times accepted FEM nodal mass times squared nodal speed; ratio to cumulative platen work is recorded at each accepted sample

checkpoint.status: must be one complete, accepted, released, settled assembly snapshot

impactor_plan.basis: 1.2 times the measured x/z extents of the fixture-free settled accepted outer roof

impact.branch_setup: restore the same accepted released FEM assembly for each mass/location; reset only its parked rigid projection, accept a zero-gravity mass/pose transaction, write a mass-matched Matter checkpoint and scene-body sidecar, then rebuild the gravity-on runner with the identical mass/inertia and restore that accepted scene state. Seed initialization is outside the 250 ms drop window.

gravity_supported_transfer.status: executable protocol; native physics result pending
gravity_supported_transfer.initial_pose: finite body tangent to accepted box roof with only an FP32 coordinate-rounding bound; no prescribed FEM node positions
gravity_supported_transfer.support_actuation: transaction-scoped upward world force on bodyIndex 4, linearly midpoint-ramped from mg to near zero while gravity remains enabled
gravity_supported_transfer.release: separate accepted zero-wrench transaction followed by continued full gravity
gravity_supported_transfer.ledger: per-step rigid momentum balance, native body contact impulse/reaction, support and gravity work, rigid/FEM kinetic energy, and gravitational potential
gravity_supported_transfer.timestep_sensitivity: repeat with --shipping-gravity-transfer-dt-us 250 and 125 from the same accepted released-assembly source; separate from impact dt refinement
